title: Global Market: Barclays expects ECB to raise rates again in December as inflation risks persist
summary: Barclays expects the European Central Bank to raise interest rates by another 25 basis points in December as persistent inflation and higher energy prices keep pressure on policymakers. The forecast follows the ECB’s latest rate hike, while markets are pricing in a high probability of another increase as oil prices remain elevated.

title: BRICS can boost local-currency trade with deeper financial markets, stronger banking links: Experts
summary: BRICS nations can boost trade and investment by deepening financial markets. Experts suggest using local currencies more often for transactions. Greater trust and business partnerships are key for future economic cooperation.
